deck_name: Sang loc + Du phong Tien san giat - 22/06/2026

cards.front: Dinh nghia ISSHP 2018 cua Tien san giat (PE)?
cards.back:
PE theo ISSHP 2018 (FIGO 2019 PMID 31111484):

HA >= 140/90 mmHg (it nhat 2 lan, cach nhau >= 4 gio) o phu nu truoc do binh thuong, SAU 20 tuan, kem MOT TRONG CAC tieu chi sau:

1. Proteinuria:
   - Protein/creatinine ratio >= 30 mg/mmol (>= 300 mg/24h)
   - Hoac dipstick >= 2+

2. Roi loan chuc nang co quan khac:
   - Than: creatinine >= 90 umol/L (1 mg/dL)
   - Gan: ALT hoac AST > 40 IU/L, co/khong kem dau ha suon phai
   - Than kinh: san giat, thay doi y thuc, mu, dot quy, clonus, dau dau nang, roi loan thi truong
   - Huyet hoc: tieu cau < 150,000/uL, DIC, tan huyet

3. Roi loan nhau thai - tu cung: FGR, abnormal umbilical artery Doppler, thai chet luu.

cards.front: Phan loai PE theo thoi diem khoi phat (theo FIGO 2019)?
cards.back:
4 loai:

1. Early-onset PE: sinh < 34+0 tuan - nguy co cao nhat, lien quan nhau bat thuong nang.
2. Preterm PE: sinh < 37+0 tuan - muc tieu chinh cua screening + aspirin du phong.
3. Late-onset PE: sinh >= 34+0 tuan - thuong nhau it bat thuong, lien quan yeu to me.
4. Term PE: sinh >= 37+0 tuan - pho bien nhat, thuong nhe.

Luu y: Phan loai khong loai tru nhau - mot benh nhan co the vua early-onset vua preterm PE.

cards.front: Co che benh sinh PE - 2-step theory?
cards.back:
Step 1: Bat thuong xam nhap te bao nuoi (trophoblast invasion)
- Tuan 8-18: trophoblast xam nhap thanh mach mau xoan (spiral arteries) cua me.
- Binh thuong: trophoblast pha huy lop co tron -> spiral arteries thanh mach co duong kinh lon, ap luc thap.
- Bat thuong: trophoblast chi xam nhap mot phan -> spiral arteries giu duong kinh nho, ap luc cao -> nhau thieu mau, stress oxy hoa.

Step 2: Mat can bang yeu to tao mach (Angiogenic imbalance)
- Nhau thieu mau tiet: tang sFlt-1 (chen VEGF, PlGF), giam PlGF.
- Hau qua: co that mach (tang HA), ton thuong noi mo (proteinuria, phu, roi loan dong mau), giam tuoi mau cac co quan (gan, than, nao, nhau).

cards.front: Biomarker huyet thanh trong PE: PlGF, sFlt-1, PAPP-A thay doi the nao?
cards.back:
PlGF (Placental Growth Factor): GIAM trong PE som (som nhat 11-13 tuan da phat hien duoc). Day la marker nhay nhat trong 3 biomarkers.

sFlt-1 (soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase-1): TANG (bieu hien ro tu 20-24 tuan tro di). Chen VEGF va PlGF -> roi loan chuc nang noi mo me.

PAPP-A: GIAM nhe (it nhay hon PlGF). Cung duoc su dung trong FMF Triple Test nhung gia tri thap hon PlGF.

Ti le sFlt-1/PlGF: SU DUNG de chan doan PE sau 20 tuan (khi ca 2 da ro). Ngoai 20 tuan ti le sFlt-1/PlGF co the phan biet PE voi chronic HTN, giai doan benh, do nang.

cards.front: Yeu to nguy co CAO cua PE (ACOG/FIGO) - chi can 1 yeu to?
cards.back:
7 yeu to nguy co CAO (chi can 1 yeu to de khuyen cao aspirin, theo ACOG 2013/2019):

1. Tien su PE (dac biet kem sinh non truoc 34 tuan) - nguy co tai phat 16-32%.
2. Benh than man.
3. Benh tu mien (SLE, APS - antiphospholipid syndrome).
4. Tang HA man (chronic hypertension).
5. Dai thao duong type 1 hoac 2.
6. Hoi chung antiphospholipid (APS).
7. Benh tim mach (suy tim, benh mach vanh,....).

cards.front: Yeu to nguy co TRUNG BINH cua PE (>= 2 yeu to)?
cards.back:
Yeu to nguy co TRUNG BINH (can >= 2 yeu to theo ACOG 2013):

1. Tuoi me >= 35.
2. BMI >= 30.
3. Tien su gia dinh PE (me/chi em).
4. Nulliparity.
5. ART (thu tinh trong ong nghiem).
6. Da thai.
7. Khoang cach thai ky > 10 nam hoac < 1 nam.
8. Sac toc: Chau Phi, Nam A.
9. Benh than, tim, mach mau co san.

Luu y: Tien su PE kem sinh non truoc 34 tuan = nguy co rat cao (tai phat 25-65%).

cards.front: So sanh 3 phuong phap sang loc PE (ACOG 2013, NICE 2019, FMF Triple Test)?
cards.back:
Theo Chaemsaithong 2022 (AJOG PMID 32682859):

1. ACOG 2013 (maternal risk factors only):
   - DR preterm PE: chi 5%.
   - DR term PE: 2%.
   - FPR: 0.2%.
   -> Kem, khong nen lam test sang loc chinh.

2. NICE 2019 (maternal risk factors):
   - DR preterm PE: 41%.
   - DR term PE: 34%.
   - FPR: 10%.
   -> Tot hon ACOG, nhung van kem FMF.

3. FMF Triple Test (maternal + MAP + PlGF + UtA-PI):
   - DR preterm PE: 75-90%.
   - DR term PE: 41-43%.
   - FPR: 10%.
   -> TOT NHAT hien nay. NNT = 250.

cards.front: FMF Triple Test gom nhung thanh phan nao? Cut-off nguy co cao?
cards.back:
FMF Triple Test = Maternal risk factors + MAP + PlGF + UtA-PI.

1. Maternal risk factors: tuoi, BMI, chung toc, parity, tien su PE, tien su gia dinh, benh nen (HTN, DM, SLE, APS, than), ART, khoang cach thai ky, hut thuoc.

2. MAP (Mean Arterial Pressure): do 2 lan, moi ben canh tay, nghi 5 phut. PE som: MAP TANG (dau hieu som nhat).

3. PlGF (Placental Growth Factor): mau me, do ELISA. PE som: PlGF GIAM (< 0.7-0.8 MoM). Day la marker nhay nhat.

4. UtA-PI (Uterine Artery Pulsatility Index): Doppler qua ca 2 dong mach tu cung. PE som: UtA-PI TANG + notching som.

Cut-off nguy co cao: >= 1:100 (theo FIGO 2019 va FMF).

Risk calculator mien phi: fetalmedicine.org/research/assess/preeclampsia

cards.front: ASPRE trial (NEJM 2017, PMID 28657417) - thiet ke va ket qua chinh?
cards.back:
Thiet ke: Multicentre, double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT.
- N = 1,776 phu nu singleton, nguy co cao preterm PE (theo FMF).
- Random 1:1: Aspirin 150 mg/dem vs Placebo.
- Tu 11-14 tuan -> 36 tuan (hoac sinh).
- Primary outcome: Preterm PE (sinh < 37 tuan).

Ket qua (FULL VERIFIED):
- Preterm PE: 1.6% (13/798) aspirin vs 4.3% (35/822) placebo.
- OR 0.38 (95% CI 0.20-0.74), p = 0.004.
- Reduction 62%.
- Adherence: 79.9% uong >= 85% lieu.
- Khong co khac biet dang ke ve adverse neonatal/other events.

cards.front: Aspirin co che gi de phong PE? Co khong tac dong len biomarker nao?
cards.back:
Co che chinh: GIAM UtA-PI (cau truc lai spiral arteries).

Theo Rolnik 2023 (UOG, PMID 37058400):
- Aspirin giam UtA-PI dang ke (p = 0.006), dac biet TRUOC 20 tuan.
- P for interaction: 0.006 (significant).

Aspirin KHONG tac dong:
- MAP trajectory (p = 0.340).
- PAPP-A trajectory (p = 0.259) - theo Rolnik 2024 (AJOG PMID 38151219).
- PlGF trajectory (p = 0.335) - theo Rolnik 2024 (AJOG PMID 38151219).

-> Co che chinh: cai thien su tai cau truc spiral arteries (giam suc can dong mach tu cung) thong qua uc che TXA2 -> uc che ket tieu tieu cau -> cai thien vi tuan hoan nhau. KHONG phai qua giam PlGF hay huyet ap.

cards.front: Aspirin lieu bao nhieu, khi nao bat dau, khi nao dung?
cards.back:
Lieu:
- FIGO, NICE, WHO, USPSTF 2024: 150 mg/dem (lieu cao - ASPRE trial).
- ACOG truoc 2019/WHO cu: 75-100 mg/dem (low-dose).
- Ly do 150 mg: ASPRE trial su dung 150 mg, DR 62%.
- Lieu duoi 100 mg: hieu qua thap hon (meta-analysis Roberge 2017).

Khi nao bat dau:
- TRUOC 16 tuan (ly tuong 11-14 tuan) - FIGO 2019.
- Sau 16 tuan: KHONG con hieu qua (Roberge meta-analysis).
- Ly do: spiral arteries phai remodeling trong giai doan som, aspirin muon khong con tac dung.

Khi nao dung:
- 36 tuan (theo ASPRE protocol).
- Hoac khi sinh.
- Hoac khi chan doan PE (tiep tuc dieu tri theo guideline PE).
- Ly do dung 36 tuan: tranh chay mau khi sinh, da du thoi gian du phong.

cards.front: Aspirin co an toan khong? Co tang LGA khong?
cards.back:
Theo Rolnik 2025 (BJOG, PMID 40590060):

- KHONG tang LGA (large-for-gestational-age): 5.5% aspirin vs 6.2% placebo (p = 0.667).
- Shift birthweight distribution tu < 2500g len 2500-4000g (cai thien nhe).
- NGOAI LE: Phu nu DAI THAO DUONG - aspirin co the tang LGA (can than trong).
- Khong tang nguy co di tat bam sinh, chay mau, hoac bong nhau.
- An toan trong 3 thang dau thai ky.

Ai KHONG nen dung aspirin:
- Di ung aspirin/NSAID.
- Loet da day - ta trang hoat dong.
- Suyren nang do aspirin.
- Roi loan dong mau (hemophilia, vWD nang).
- Benh gan nang (giai doan cuoi).

cards.front: Yeu to nao du bao that bai voi aspirin? (Shen 2021, PMID 33998099)
cards.back:
Theo Shen 2021 (UOG, PMID 33998099) - phan tich phu ASPRE:

1. Chronic hypertension: Aspirin KHONG co effect (p interaction = 0.042). Yeu to quan trong nhat.

2. Risk rat cao (1:2 den 1:10): 7x cao hon so voi 1:51-1:100 (aOR 6.71, 95% CI 2.38-18.88).

3. Risk cao (1:11 den 1:50): 3x cao hon (aOR 2.77, 95% CI 1.11-6.94).

4. PlGF < 0.712 MoM (cut-off toi uu): 3.7x cao hon (aOR 3.68, 95% CI 1.53-8.86).

-> Phu nu co chronic HTN can theo doi sat du aspirin - thuoc co the khong du hieu qua. Nhom rat cao (1:2-1:10) can can nhac bien phap bo sung.

cards.front: Calcium trong du phong PE - chi dinh, lieu, hieu qua?
cards.back:
Theo FIGO 2019 (PMID 31111484) + WHO 2011:

Chi dinh: Phu nu co CALCIUM INTAKE < 800 mg/ngay (pho bien o cac nuoc thu nhap thap).

Lieu: 1.5-2 g elemental calcium/ngay (chia 3 lan, tu sau 20 tuan).

Co che: Giam co that mach, on dinh noi mo.

Hieu qua (WHO 2011): Giam ~50% PE, dac biet EARLY-ONSET PE.

Luu y: O cac nuoc phat trien co calcium intake du, KHONG co evidence ro rang ve loi ich.

Nguon calcium: thuc pham giau canxi (sua, pho mat, rau la xanh) hoac vien bo sung (calcium carbonate, citrate).

cards.front: Magnesium trong PE - khi nao dung, lieu?
cards.back:
Magnesium sulfate (MgSO4):

- KHONG khuyen cao du phong thuong quy.
- CHI DUNG trong:
  1. ECLAMPSIA (san giat) - dieu tri + phong ngua tai phat.
  2. SEVERE PREECLAMPSIA gan sinh (trong vong 24h) - de:
     - Phong ngua san giat.
     - Bao ve nao thai nhi (neuroprotection) - dac biet < 32 tuan.

Lieu (theo ACOG/MAGPIE trial):
- Loading dose: 4-6 g IV trong 15-20 phut.
- Maintenance: 1-2 g/hr IV lien tuc.
- Tiep tuc 24h sau sinh (hoac 24h sau con giat cuoi cung neu eclampsia).

Can theo doi: phan xa (knee jerk), Mg nhiem than (RR < 12, SpO2 < 95%, urine output < 100 mL/4h) -> giam lieu hoac dung.

Antidote: calcium gluconate 1g IV.

cards.front: Cac bien phap du phong PE nao KHONG khuyen cao?
cards.back:
5 bien phap KHONG khuyen cao theo WHO 2011 / SMFM 2020 / FIGO 2019:

1. Heparin trong luong phan tu thap (LMWH):
   - KHONG du phong PE o thai phu thuong.
   - Chi can nhac trong APS (khop aspirin + LMWH).

2. Nghi ngoi, han che van dong:
   - KHONG co evidence giam PE.
   - Co the tang nguy co DVT.

3. Che do an, chat chong oxy hoa (vitamin C/E, lycopene):
   - Meta-analysis khong thay loi ich.

4. Vitamin D bo sung thuong quy (ACOG):
   - Chi bo sung neu thieu (theo khuyen cao chung cho thai ky).

5. Magnesium du phong thuong quy:
   - Chi dung trong eclampsia hoac severe PE gan sinh.

cards.front: Algorithm sang loc PE theo FIGO 2019 (FMF Triple Test)?
cards.back:
Thai 11-13+6 tuan:

1. Thu thap: maternal factors + MAP + PlGF + UtA-PI.
2. Su dung FMF risk calculator (fetalmedicine.org).

3. Nguy co cao: >= 1:100 -> Aspirin 150 mg/dem (cho den 36 tuan hoac sinh).
4. Nguy co trung binh: 1:101-1:1000 -> Theo doi sat (co the can nhac aspirin 75-100 mg).
5. Nguy co thap: < 1:1000 -> Routine prenatal care.

Contingent screening (cho he thong nguon luc han che):
- Buoc 1: maternal factors + MAP cho tat ca.
- Buoc 2: chi do PlGF + UtA-PI cho nhom nguy co trung binh-cao sau buoc 1.
- Tiet kiem chi phi, van duy tri detection rate cao.

cards.front: PE nang (severe features) theo ACOG 2019?
cards.back:
PE nang (severe features) theo ACOG 2019 (Practice Bulletin #202) va ISSHP 2018:

1. HA >= 160/110 mmHg.
2. Tieu cau < 100,000/uL.
3. Men gan tang gap doi binh thuong (ALT/AST > 2x ULN).
4. Suy than cap (creatinine > 1.1 mg/dL hoac tang gap doi).
5. Phu phoi.
6. Trieu chung than kinh moi (dau dau nang, roi loan thi truong, co gat - san giat).
7. Dau ha suon phai du doi.

Xu tri: nhap vien, magnesium sulfate (neu co chi dinh), kiem soat HA (hydralazine, labetalol, nifedipine), corticosteroid (neu < 34 tuan), can nhac sinh som tuy thai.

cards.front: ASPRE secondary analysis: Aspirin + birthweight + LGA (Rolnik 2025)?
cards.back:
Theo Rolnik 2025 (BJOG, PMID 40590060):

- N = 1,571 singleton live neonates (777 aspirin, 794 placebo).
- Aspirin shift birthweight distribution tu < 2500g len 2500-4000g.
- KHONG tang LGA (large-for-gestational-age): 5.5% aspirin vs 6.2% placebo (p = 0.667).
- Tang LGA chi o phu nu DAI THAO DUONG (interaction p = 0.034): can than trong.
- Maternal weight la yeu to doc lap manh nhat (aOR 1.040, 95% CI 1.030-1.051, p < 0.001).

-> Aspirin co loi cho birthweight nhe (giam SGA) ma khong gay LGA - profile an toan tot.

cards.front: Nicolaides 2024 (BJOG, PMID 37749709) - ASPRE + SPREE: hieu qua aspirin theo loai PTB?
cards.back:
Phan tich ket hop SPREE (N=16,451) + ASPRE (N=1,620):

| Outcome | Detection rate (FMF Triple Test) | Detection rate (NICE) | Aspirin effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| Spontaneous PTB (sPTB) | 17% | 12% | 14% reduction |
| Iatrogenic PTB do PE (iPTB-PE) | 82% | 39% | 65% reduction |
| Iatrogenic PTB khong do PE (iPTB-noPE) | 25% | 19% | 0% reduction |

-> Triple Test + aspirin HIEU QUA DAC BIET trong viec giam iPTB-PE (65% reduction), khong anh huong sPTB/iPTB-noPE.

-> Ly do aspirin giam iPTB-PE: phong ngua PE som -> tranh sinh non can thiep do PE nang. Khong phong ngua sinh non do nguyen nhan khac.
